Container.Name: sd-character-viewer
Container.Overview:
Web gallery for browsing Stable Diffusion character images and videos stored on disk as characters/{style}/{character}/*.png (or .mp4), with character, style and pose filters, ratings, a duplicate finder, Upscale/Animate marking and optional password protection.
The images folder must contain the characters folder. It is mounted read/write because ratings, marks, renames, deletes and preview thumbnails are written there; set it to read-only if you only browse and leave Allow Destructive Actions off.

Config.Name: Images
Config.Description: Images root: the folder that contains the characters folder (and config.json, characters.json, ratings.json...).

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: Library index and first-seen (new image) cache.

Config.Name: Extra images
Config.Description: Optional. An extra images root (contains a characters folder), or a parent folder whose subfolders are each an images root. Merged into the same library; ignored when left empty.

Config.Name: Allow destructive actions
Config.Description: Enables delete, Redraw, rating, rename, the Library Toolbox, the Duplicate Finder's Validate and Upscale/Animate marking.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional. Shows a login screen when set. Requires the password salt below.

Config.Name: Password salt
Config.Description: Required when a password is set: any random string, used to hash the password.

Config.Name: SD_IMAGES_ROOT
Config.Description: Container path of the images root. Leave as is.

Config.Name: SD_EXTRA_IMAGES_ROOT
Config.Description: Container path of the extra images. Leave as is.

Config.Name: SD_CACHE_DIR
Config.Description: Container path of the cache. Leave as is.

Config.Name: Library cache TTL (seconds)
Config.Description: How long the library index is trusted before checking the folders again for files added outside the app. 0 checks on every request.

Config.Name: Preview max dimension
Config.Description: Longest edge, in pixels, of generated preview thumbnails.

Config.Name: Preview JPEG quality
Config.Description: JPEG quality (1-100) of image preview thumbnails.

Config.Name: Background sync
Config.Description: Runs the first-seen/preview sync script at startup and then periodically.

Config.Name: Background sync interval (seconds)
Config.Description: Delay between two background sync runs.
